QuestInfo.name: [Daily Quest] Fogo Family Reuinion
QuestInfo.0: Fogo Vermelho in Orbis has something to tell you. Go and find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1:
Fogo Vermelho in Orbis asks you to capture his son Fogo Azul.
Since Fogo Azul can create mirror images, nabbing him may take multiple attempts.
Fogo Vermelho gives you a bottle to capture Fogo Azul. 
#bUse the empty bottle Fogo Vermelho gave you on Fogo Azul#k.
QuestInfo.2:
Fogo Vermelho in Orbis asks you to capture his son Fogo Azul.
Since Fogo Azul can create mirror images, nabbing him may take multiple attempts.
You put Fogo Azul in the empty bottle and brought it to Fogo Vermelho.
Fogo Vermelho said it was not his son, and #rasked that you help him again tomorrow#k.

default.0: Did you find my son, Fogo Azul? \r\nCapture him in the empty bottle I gave you,\r\nand bring it to me.
